'''Ancient Tablet''' is a [[unique item]].  It first appeared in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game.

==Card info==
'''Movement''': Spend 3 movement points and discard Ancient Tablet to roll 2 dice.  For every success rolled, draw 1 [[Spell]].  For every failure rolled, gain 2 [[Clue token]]s.

'''Price''': $8
